content.text:
I reviewed the transcript, paying attention to the in-meeting corrections ($395,000 → $358,000; hearing October 30 → October 13; worksheet Friday the 18th → Friday the 25th; lender shopping → Fallowbrook only).

**Pairings:** 11 of 12 key items are captured. The one gap is **i7** — the full cash-flow projection and age-65 retirement projection (Moderate allocation, support ending 2033, Social Security own-record vs. divorced-spouse comparison), owned by Silas and due at the November 10 meeting. It was explicitly restated in the wrap-up list and does not appear anywhere in the record.

**Figures/owners/dates:** All matched items carry the final corrected values — $358,000 (48.93%), $212,400, $45,000, $118,000→$127,500, the October 13 hearing date, and the September 25 worksheet deadline. No stale figures survived.

**Non-actions:** Clean. The maiden-name change (deferred), the $300,000 term policy on Gavin (declined "in bold"), and the $40,000 cash distribution from the QDRO (declined in favor of full rollover) are all absent from the action lists. Record 6 mentions the Kettridge titling but only as the account name actually chosen, which is the opposite of the deferred proposal.

**Extras:** Records 3, 4 and 5 are settlement terms stated plainly in the transcript and correctly figured. Record 6 splits out the account-opening step already contained within records 7 and 8.

key_items.note: Signing date Sept 10 and final hearing Oct 13 both match; record used the corrected 13th, not the misspoken 30th.
Title, Oct 1 effective date, and $118,000 to $127,500 all match.
$358,000 is the corrected settled figure (not the stale $395,000); 48.93% and in-kind/judgment-entry conditioning match Noor's rerun.
$212,400 plus/minus gains and losses, direct rollover from the Vellamy Freight 401(k) to the new rollover IRA.
$45,000 of T-bills sold in the new individual account, proceeds to Fallowbrook savings.
Graciela owns it; 2026-09-17 is the agreed 'tomorrow' (tonight if possible).
Due date reflects the renegotiated Friday the 25th, not the initial Friday the 18th.
Correctly assigned to Graciela with Fallowbrook as the lender after Silas dropped his plan to line up lenders; end-of-October due date right.
Noor owns the Friday 2026-09-18 e-sign packet; individual app, rollover IRA app, LOA and the new questionnaire/IPS all listed.
50/50 split with sister as custodian for Mateo; correctly gated to judgment entry on 2026-10-13 per the automatic restraining order.
Silas owns the QDRO review with comments back to Joanna by Monday 2026-09-21.

Missing entirely. Silas committed to the full cash-flow projection and age-65 retirement projection (Moderate, support ending 2033, own-record vs divorced-spouse Social Security) for the Nov 10 meeting; restated in the closing recap but never recorded.

extra_items.note: Transcript states spousal support of $2,850/month for seven years beginning November 1, 2026 (running through October 2033).
Transcript states child support of $1,410/month until Mateo graduates in June 2028.
Post-529 costs split 50/50; about $18,000/year after scholarship so her half is ~$9,000, starting next fall.
Splits out the account-opening step already contained in items 7 and 8, which each specify the new individual brokerage account and the new rollover IRA.
